about.title: About us
about.lead: We started by fitting out small offices in Cairo with one idea: a good chair and a solid desk change how you work.
body: Today we furnish home offices, gaming rooms and whole companies across Egypt. Every chair and desk we sell is one we have sat in, adjusted and tested for long days.
We keep the range focused: ergonomic office chairs, gaming chairs, desks that don't wobble, meeting tables and smart storage.
Our own team delivers and assembles in every governorate, and you only pay when your furniture is set up.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.lead: Questions about a piece, an order or delivery? We're happy to help.

shipping.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping.lead: Simple and fair, with no surprises at the door.

sections.title: Delivery
sections.text: We deliver to all 27 governorates for one flat fee. Most orders arrive within 3–7 working days. We call you before we dispatch to agree on a time.

sections.title: Payment
sections.text: Pay in cash when your order arrives. Please check the items in front of the courier before paying.

sections.title: Returns
sections.text: If something arrives damaged or isn't what you ordered, refuse it at the door or contact us within 14 days and we'll collect it and refund or replace it.

services.title: Our services
services.lead: More than furniture: we help you plan your workspace, deliver it and set it up.

items.title: Delivery to every governorate
items.text: Our own team delivers to your door anywhere in Egypt, carefully packed and on the day we agree with you.

items.title: Free assembly
items.text: We assemble chairs, desks and meeting tables in place and take the packaging away with us.

items.title: Office fit-out
items.text: Furnishing a whole office? Send us your floor plan and we'll suggest a layout, quantities and a single quote.

items.title: Ergonomic advice
items.text: Not sure which chair or desk height suits you? Tell us your height and how you work and we'll recommend a setup.

items.title: Cash on delivery
items.text: Pay only when your furniture arrives and you've checked it.

items.title: Warranty and after-sales
items.text: If a mechanism or part fails, call or message us and we'll arrange a fix or a replacement.

footer.tagline: Office and gaming furniture, delivered across Egypt.
